meta.name: Hercules Unchained
meta.description:
Hercules returns to Thebes to find the land on the brink of civil war. While trying to deliver a treaty to prevent the war, Hercules drinks from the fountain of forgetfulness and is seduced by the evil Omphale.

An AVI of this movie is available here on the archive.

You can find out more about this movie on its IMDB page.
